_note: The source registry (docs/data-sources.md section 4): one entry per outside source, with its cadence, hosts, whether a key is needed, the dated robots.txt and terms checks, the verdict under the watcher rule (docs/county-data-build-vs-buy.md 3.4) and the principal's decision. This first set is the county foreclosure-notice watchers, from the recon of 2026-11-18 (docs/county-watchers-recon.md). A rule file: sources only, NO prospect data, NO borrower, lender or person names. verdict is allowed, not_allowed or unclear; only an allowed source may be enabled, and enabled means cleared to build and run, not that an adapter exists. adapter names the county adapter in src/counties.mjs that reads the source (one adapter may read several of a county's reports); a source with an adapter stays not enabled, with what it is waitingOn, until a principal records the decision (principalDecision, the adapter's terms and config.counties.sources). fields says where each field of a notice appears: list (on the list page itself), document (only on the linked notice), absent, or not_seen (the source could not be read). Requests send the User-Agent in config.json (fdic.userAgent) and stay at or under 3 a minute per host, or slower where robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay. A terms check older than a year, a new challenge page, a block or a cease-and-desist letter stops the source until a principal decides.

terms.automatedAccess: not forbidden; unreasonable load and circumventing rate limits are
terms.quote: You may read, print and download material from this site for personal, non-commercial use, and for any use permitted by the Texas Public Information Act. You may not: ... use automated means to place an unreasonable load on the site, or to circumvent its rate limits; harvest personal information from the site for solicitation
terms.version: effective 21 August 2026; the page says it is under review by the County District Attorney's office

sources.verdictBasis: An official list the law requires to be public; robots.txt allows the list and the files; the terms allow PIA-permitted use and forbid only unreasonable load; no login, CAPTCHA or challenge.
conditions: One list request a week (twice a week if a principal wants more warning) plus only the PDFs that are new, 21 seconds apart.

Borrower names and any individual named in a notice are never used for outreach, never leave principal context, and are not harvested for solicitation; the signal is the enforcing lender, an institution.
Recheck the disclaimer monthly while the District Attorney's review is open.

principalDecision.use: Lender-level use only, as a use permitted by the Texas Public Information Act; never harvesting personal information for solicitation.
conditions: Lender-level use only: the signal is the enforcing lender, an institution.
No borrower, and no individual named in a notice, is ever contacted from this data.
Recheck the county's disclaimer monthly, because it is under review by the County District Attorney's office.

sources.name: Jefferson County Public Trustee: weekly Election and Demand Notices Filed (GTS report)
sources.format: GTS report index (HTML by GET: an h2 per month, then ol > li with span posted date, a[href='Report_Files/{file}.pdf'], span description) linking one text-based PDF a week (Acrobat Distiller, embedded fonts), e.g. 'NED M-D-YYYY.pdf'. The archive index /report?t=14 holds one PDF a month.
sources.fieldNotes: Each record: Foreclosure Number; NED Date and its Reception #; Original Sale Date; Deed of Trust Date, Recording Date and Reception #; Re-Recording; Legal (an 'APN #:' inside it in 3 of 11 records sampled); Address; Original Note Amt; LoanType (Conventional, FHA, VA, Commercial, BPL Commercial, business seen); Interest Rate and Type; Current Amount and As Of; Current Lender (Beneficiary); Current Owner; Grantee (Lender On Deed of Trust); Grantor (Borrower On Deed of Trust); Publication and its first and last dates; Attorney for Beneficiary, Attorney File Number, Phone. The PDF is the list: no linked documents.
sources.history: Weekly PDFs for the current month; monthly compilations from January 2025 to October 2026 in the archive (/report?t=14)

The GTS search page (an 'Accept Terms' POST button and a hidden reCAPTCHA field) is never used.

sources.name: Jefferson County Public Trustee: weekly Pre Sale List (GTS report)
sources.format: GTS report index (as for the NED report) linking one text-based PDF, a Crystal Reports layout printed through Acrobat Distiller. The file name repeats each week ('Preliminary bid report-Tuesday.pdf'), so a run keys on the ETag or Last-Modified and the sale date in the header, not the name.
sources.fieldNotes: Header: '<County> County Pre Sale Foreclosure List', run date and time, 'Sale Date:'. Each record: 'Foreclosure: #:', 'The Grantor:', 'Legal Description:' (a 'PARCEL:' number in 8 of 11 sampled), 'Street Address:', 'Current Beneficiary Name:', 'First Publication:', 'Last Publication:', 'Publication Newspaper:', 'Lender's Bid Amount:', 'Deficiency:', 'Total Indebtedness:'. Trailer 'Total Foreclosures:'.

terms.automatedAccess: not addressed: a disclaimer on the list's timeliness only
terms.quote: THE PROPERTIES THAT APPEAR ON THE WEEKLY SALE/AUCTION LIST OF THE PUBLIC TRUSTEE'S OFFICE ARE TIMELY AND VALID ONLY AS OF THE DATE AND TIME THEY ARE POSTED.

sources.verdictBasis: As for the NED report: an official weekly list by GET, no robots.txt, nothing in the terms on automated access, no login, CAPTCHA or challenge.
conditions: The same as the NED report. A sale-week signal: it confirms which NED cases reach a sale, and their bid and indebtedness.
sources.waitingOn: The same decision as the NED report: one adapter reads both.
